gap_details.2011-2012: No program roster page for any host before 2015-08 (Wayback prefix audits of georgetownuniversityhospital.org, medstargeorgetown.org, medstarhealth.org/education, som/gumc.georgetown.edu, guessed hosts; Common Crawl 2013-2014 crawls: 0 roster records). Reconstructed alumni-confirmed graduates of 2012-2018 only; PGY from graduation year.
gap_details.2012-2013: As 2011-12. The 2012 entry class (PGY-1 in 2012-13, would graduate 2019) is unknown: no 2019 graduates on the alumni page and no PGY-3 class on the 2014-15 roster. Phase 2: PubMed (Georgetown[ad] AND neurosurgery, 772 PMIDs 2011-2025) and MedStar Washington Hospital Center neurosurgery affiliations show no unaccounted resident 2012-2019; every unlisted Georgetown-neurosurgery author was a medical student, research fellow, attending or resident elsewhere (Oermann, Yaeger, Murthy, Chidambaram, Lajthia, Alqahtani, Rotter, H. Alexander, Samir Sur = Miami resident then GU faculty, J.A. Thomas = attending).
gap_details.2013-2014: As 2011-12. Reconstructed alumni graduates 2014-2020 (Conte/Mueller as PGY-1 also confirmed at PGY-2 in 2014-15).
gap_details.2014-2015: Observed via a STALE page: current-residents-19 captured 2015-08-22..2016-05-31 still shows 2014-15 content (Petteys/Spitz, 2015 graduates, at top; the recent-graduates page of the same date ends at 2014). Labels 'NS-6..NS-1' number the six listed classes sequentially; PGYs assigned from alumni graduation years (NS-2 = PGY-2, NS-1 = PGY-1; no PGY-3 class).
gap_details.2015-2016: No 2015-16 content ever published/archived: page stayed on 2014-15 content until 2016-07. Reconstructed from bracketing (2014-15 & 2016-17) and alumni years; Fayed/Tai (2015 entrants) via alumni grad 2022 + 2016-17 PGY-2.
gap_details.2016-2017: Observed (Wayback 2016-10-05; unchanged 2016-07..2016-11). Page labels top classes PGY-6/PGY-5; corrected to PGY-7/6 for Felbaum/Ryan (2017 grads) and Jha/McGowan (2018 grads).

gap_details.2026-2027: Live page 2026-09-27 (= Wayback 2026-09-07); advanced and has new interns. NIH-track (McAbee, Roehrkasse, Der, Chen, Presto) excluded.

departures.name: Raed Moustafa
departures.note: 2014 entrant (PGY-1 2014-15, PGY-3 2016-17). Not on alumni page (classmate Lynes graduated 2021 alone). Left sometime 2017-2021; exact year hidden by the 2017-2023 roster gap. Phase 2: no PubMed/OpenAlex output under his name, NPPES record (1306264064) never updated after 2014-03-31 (student taxonomy, DC). training_history row added (completed=no, departure_type=unknown, end_year NULL).

joiners.name: Alex Waldman
joiners.note: Absent from Jan/Feb 2026 rosters; appears as PGY-1 in the June 2026 capture and PGY-2 in 2026-27. Mid-year/off-cycle addition to the 2025 class (which had only Georgia Wong plus NIH-track Mizrachi). First full-year appearance 2026-27 at PGY-2.
